title: National Camel & Desert Racing Championships
subtitle: Extreme Desert Environment RF Wireless & High-Speed Mobile OB
venue: Al Dhafra Festival, Al Wathbah, Muzayna, Al Labsah
role: Senior OB Engineer & RF Wireless Signal Specialist
summary: Pioneered specialized mobile OB operations in extreme desert conditions (45°C heat, fine sandstorms) with high-speed tracking vehicles, long-range Vislink RF camera links, and dynamic desert sun shading.

specs.replay: EVS XT3 Max (8 Channel) with Multicam LSM
specs.cameras: Sony HDC-3500 + Grass Valley LDX 86N + Gyro-Stabilized Tracking Cams
specs.syncRouter: Vislink Wireless RF Receivers + Nevion 64x64 SDI
specs.audioIntercom: Midas Pro 2 Digital Audio + RTS Telex Intercom

technicalApproach: Engineered multi-node RF diversity antenna arrays across 8km–10km desert tracks with automated antenna switching.
Customized positive-pressure dust filtration and secondary cooling for OB truck server racks during desert sand conditions.
Maintained extreme dynamic range CCU shading between golden desert sand dunes and high-intensity Arabian midday sun.

signalFlow.description: Gyro-stabilized cameras on 4x4 chase vehicles transmitting over Vislink RF
Triple antenna receiver masts along 10km race perimeter
COFDM receivers demodulating RF signals directly into OB router
LSM operators logging lead camel split times and photo-finish angles
Microwave link direct to YAS TV teleport station

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Extreme desert heat causing RF transmitter thermal throttling on lead tracking vehicle during 10km race.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Installed custom aluminum heatsink ducted fans with quick-swap cold gel packs between race heats.
challengesAndSolutions.impact: Maintained 100% RF signal power output with zero frame drops throughout all heats.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Intense sand glare blowing out camera dynamic range on standard gamma curves.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Engineered a custom S-Log/HyperGamma knee curve preset on Sony RCP-1500 paint boxes, protecting sky and sand highlights.
challengesAndSolutions.impact: Rich, broadcast-award-winning visual color fidelity praised by YAS TV production team.

outcomes: Over 240 live desert races broadcast without a single dropped race finish or signal dropout.
Recognized by Media Mania as the premier RF & OB engineering lead for Gulf heritage sports.
improvementReflection: Implementing automated GPS-steered tracking antennas on receiver towers would further enhance signal margin on extreme 12km marathons.
